name: Villalcázar de Sirga (Spain)
description: Vertically divided white and blue, the white hoist third charged with the crowned municipal arms of Villalcázar de Sirga (crosses on blue, a castle on white and a crescent).
history: Municipal flag of Villalcázar de Sirga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villalcázar de Sirga arms — crosses on blue, castle on white and crescent
